requirements.text: Provision Peer Device — Browse opens .ppkg picker; Transfer/Cancel Transfer are Collapsed/NFC-gated
requirements.reason: Structural coverage 2/3: Browse present & functional (opens the .ppkg file picker), Transfer matched, Cancel Transfer absent. Transfer and Cancel Transfer are Visibility=Collapsed / NFC-hardware-gated in BOTH the UWP golden and the WinUI app, so their absence is not a regression. Held at partial only because the WinUI window screenshots blank/white (DirectComposition GDI-capture limitation) so visual parity could not be positively confirmed.
requirements.suspected_skill_gap: None on the migration side — Scenario1.xaml is byte-identical to source and behaves. The residual gap is the eval harness's GDI screenshot of a DirectComposition surface (measurement instrument), not the migration skill.

visual_discrepancies.uwp: Scenario content visible in golden capture
visual_discrepancies.winui: Blank/white frame via winapp GDI capture despite UIA reporting all controls on-screen (isOffscreen=false) and Browse behaviorally live

summary: Migration is faithful (byte-identical Scenario1.xaml, working Browse picker, 0 behavioral regressions). Score capped at 50 by a WinUI 3 DirectComposition GDI-capture limitation in the eval harness, not a migration defect. The high-value skill lesson comes from the dev-agent's build/runtime journey: a 0x802B000A launch crash caused by shared sample-style resource keys (StandardStyles.xaml / sample App.xaml) not migrated into the scaffold.
